info.title: KiriChess API
info.description: The KiriChess HTTP API. This document is generated (Phase 9d.7) - see docs/api/openapi.json, generated by `dotnet run --project src/KiriChess.Server -- --export-openapi`, and ui/lib/api.generated.ts, generated from that file by `npm run gen:api` in ui/. The SignalR hubs at /hubs/game and /hubs/presence are real-time, not HTTP, so their payload schemas (Phase 9e.9) live in components.schemas referenced by no path, each marked with the x-kirichess-transport extension naming the hub and the event or method it belongs to. The published third-party surface is /api/v1 and lives in a separate document.
